svg.title: Open WebUI Production Kubernetes Architecture
svg.desc: Full K8s architecture flowchart showing traffic from Internet through Ingress, Frontend API, Redis, PostgreSQL, Vector DB, Object Storage, Inference Gateway, and GPU backends with explanations for each component.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What protocols does the internet layer use for Open WebUI?')
sendPrompt('Why do we need an Ingress controller in Kubernetes for Open WebUI?')
g.text: NGINX / Traefik · TLS termination · routing rules

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should Open WebUI API pods be configured for horizontal scaling?')
g.text: Stateless · CPU-bound · WebSocket/SSE heavy · HPA enabled

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why is Redis critical for Open WebUI production and what is Redis Sentinel?')
sendPrompt('Why replace SQLite with PostgreSQL HA and what is CloudNativePG?')
sendPrompt('Why use Qdrant as the vector database in Open WebUI and what is it used for?')
sendPrompt('Why store uploaded files in MinIO or S3 instead of inside the pod?')
sendPrompt('What does the LLM inference gateway do in an Open WebUI deployment?')
g.text: Load balance · model routing · queue-aware · autoscale

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why use vLLM for high-concurrency LLM inference instead of Ollama?')
sendPrompt('What is Ollama best suited for and why is it not recommended for production scale?')
sendPrompt('When should you use TGI or external APIs like OpenAI with Open WebUI?')
sendPrompt('How does token streaming work in Open WebUI — SSE vs WebSocket?')
sendPrompt('What secrets should be stored in Kubernetes Secrets for Open WebUI?')
sendPrompt('What configuration goes into ConfigMaps for an Open WebUI Helm chart?')
sendPrompt('Which components need PersistentVolumeClaims in Open WebUI and why?')
sendPrompt('What NetworkPolicies should be defined between Open WebUI namespaces?')
sendPrompt('How does HPA work for Open WebUI API pods and inference pods?')
sendPrompt('Why are PodDisruptionBudgets important for Open WebUI HA?')
sendPrompt('What is the recommended observability stack for a Kubernetes Open WebUI deployment?')
sendPrompt('How do you set up Grafana dashboards for Open WebUI GPU inference monitoring?')
sendPrompt('What should be logged from Open WebUI pods for production debugging?')
